name: grover-podcast
description: Grover Podcast - The ultimate app to manage your favorite podcasts on Windows

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run minify-css && npm run minify-js && npm run copy-assets && npm run create-dist-html
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && npm run optimize-images
scripts.minify-css: mkdir -p dist/assets/css && cleancss -o dist/assets/css/style.min.css assets/css/style.css && cleancss -o dist/assets/css/stars-review.min.css assets/css/stars-review.css && cleancss -o dist/assets/css/chart.min.css assets/css/chart.css && cleancss -o dist/assets/css/table.min.css assets/css/table.css
scripts.minify-js: mkdir -p dist/assets/js && uglifyjs assets/js/main.js -o dist/assets/js/main.min.js && uglifyjs assets/js/navbar.js -o dist/assets/js/navbar.min.js && cp assets/js/jquery.min.js dist/assets/js/
scripts.copy-assets: cp -r assets/img dist/assets/ && cp robots.txt dist/ && cp sitemap.xml dist/

author: Matheus Inácio
